sections.lever checks:
- Family and target: picking the right measure plus an unprinted count (hook h14, sketch i03): Alabama's awarded total beside a larger total that adds anticipated money, and a facility count that exists only as a numbered permit list in another section. Target medium (user 2026-10-10: no Easy slot, "target medium and high"). The task page lists "Picking the right measure" among the shapes it is short of. Measured platform result pending; no quick test yet.
- Dependency plan: Doc 5 L276 awarded $1,069,479 (anticipated $203,390 more, total $1,272,869); L397-L398 permits issued for facilities (1)-(8) -> 1,069,479 / 8 = 133,684.875. Doc 3 L226 8 facilities and $571,396.00 received; L329 all CCR units permitted -> 571,396.00 / 8 = 71,424.5. Difference 62,260.375 -> $62,260.
- Universe: Alabama's permitted facilities are the eight listed at L397-L398 (Miller, Greene County, Gadsden, Barry, Gaston, Lowman, Gorgas, TVA Colbert); the list is introduced as the facilities ADEM issued permits for, after "All owners and operators of CCR units within the State applied for a permit". Virginia: 8 facilities (L226), every unit permitted (L329). Wyoming and Louisiana have issued no State CCR permits (D02 L302, D04 L400) and are not asked about.
- Necessity: Doc 5 is the only source of Alabama's award and of its permitted facilities (grep "1,069,479", "issued permits for the following": D05 only). Doc 3 is the only source of Virginia's $571,396.00, its 8 facilities and the all-units-permitted statement (grep: D03 L226, L329). Doc 2 prints an equal $571,396, but for Wyoming (4 facilities, no State permits issued), so it cannot stand in for Doc 3. Without either document that State's per-facility figure is unknown.
- Selected-lever checks: Scatter the pieces: Alabama's award (L276) and its facility list (L397-L398) are 120 lines apart, and Virginia's inputs are in two sections of Doc 3. State the rounding: 62,260.375 rounds to 62,260; no input has a second stated value. Calculate across documents: one per-facility figure from each document, then a subtraction. No which-items decoy applies.
- Targeted failure modes: mode 1 (Look-alike measure / Takes the wrong line item): Doc 5 L276 "for a total of $1,272,869"; 1,272,869 / 8 = 159,108.625 and 159,108.625 - 71,424.5 = 87,684.125 -> $87,684. Recomputed 2026-10-10. Considered and not declared: dividing by units instead of facilities (1,069,479 / 16 - 571,396 / 25 = 43,986.60), which the wording "per facility" rules out; taking Wyoming's equal figure for Virginia's (same dollars, wrong State and facility count).
- Calculation verification: python 2026-10-10 (caller): 1069479 / 8 = 133684.875; 571396 / 8 = 71424.5; difference 62260.375; check 1069479 + 203390 = 1272869; wrong route 87684.125.
- Semantic/ID/overview probes: no document prints a per-facility funding figure or a facility count for Alabama (L279's footnote sends the reader to the State's application). The page overview lists Doc 2's "$571,396 in funding" (Wyoming) and no Alabama or Virginia funding figure. Shortest route: Doc 5 L276 and L397-L398, Doc 3 L226 and L329, two divisions and a subtraction.
- Precision/readings: "had ... been awarded" excludes the anticipated $203,390; "holding a State-issued coal-ash permit" selects Alabama's eight listed facilities and all eight of Virginia's; "per facility" compares each State's own figure (with eight on both sides this equals the gap divided by eight); "to the nearest dollar" fixes 62,260.375 -> 62,260.
- Completeness: full corpus, no gaps (intake: incomplete false, gap 0 for all six documents).
- Style/set review: 24 words, one ask; "STAG" and the State names are identifiers, the rest is paraphrase. q01 uses Doc 3's public-participation sentence and Doc 2; no shared fact or hint. Sketch i04 (five-State awarded total) shares the Alabama measure choice, so at most one of q02/i04 is submitted.
- Warnings answered: see the hand-over note; filled after the floor run.

sections.question: Per facility holding a State-issued coal-ash permit, how much more STAG funding had Alabama been awarded than Virginia had received, to the nearest dollar?
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Source input (Doc 5, Alabama CCR Units and Resources): "ADEM has been awarded a total of $1,069,479 from EPA's CCR State and Tribal Assistance Grants (STAG) funding." The same paragraph also prints a larger total that adds an amount EPA only "anticipates ADEM will be awarded"; that money is not yet awarded and is left out.
Step 2. Source input (Doc 5, Alabama's Permits Issued Under the State CCR Regulations): ADEM "issued permits for the following CCR facilities", a list numbered (1) to (8), from the James H. Miller Electric Generating Plant to the TVA Colbert Plant. Alabama therefore has 8 facilities holding State coal-ash permits; the units paragraph gives no facility count.
Step 3. Calculation (Doc 5): Alabama's awarded funding per permitted facility, in dollars: 1,069,479 / 8 = 133,684.875.
Step 4. Source input (Doc 3, Virginia CCR Units and Resources): VADEQ identified its disposal units "at 8 facilities in Virginia" and "has received $571,396.00 in funding to develop its CCR permit program", after applying for STAG funding.
Step 5. Source input (Doc 3, Virginia's Permits Issued Under the Commonwealth CCR Regulations): "VADEQ issued permits to the owners and/or operators of all CCR units in the Commonwealth", so all 8 Virginia facilities hold State permits.
Step 6. Calculation (Doc 3): Virginia's funding per permitted facility, in dollars: 571,396.00 / 8 = 71,424.5.
Step 7. Final answer (Doc 3 and Doc 5): Alabama's excess per permitted facility, in dollars: 133,684.875 - 71,424.5 = 62,260.375. To the nearest dollar the fraction drops, giving the gold answer.
sections.targeted failure modes:
### Failure mode 1
Trap: Look-alike measure
How a careless solver fails: Takes the wrong line item

Why these are traps: Look-alike measure: Doc 5's resources paragraph prints $1,272,869 beside the $1,069,479 awarded; that larger total adds $203,390 EPA only anticipates. Taking it gives $159,109 per facility and $87,684 more than Virginia. The gold uses the awarded figure over Doc 5's eight permitted facilities: $62,260.
